name: Aka Multi Terminal
author: akaanakbaik17@proton.me
description:
AKA MULTI TERMINAL FOR PTERODACTYL

Universal terminal egg untuk bot, website, API, scraper, compiler, dan tunnel.

Supported runtimes:
- Node.js 18, 20, 22, dan latest via NVM auto-switch
- Bun latest
- Deno latest
- Python 3 + pip + venv + uv + poetry + pipenv
- PHP CLI + Composer + ekstensi umum
- C/C++ GCC/G++ + Clang + CMake + Make
- Java 21
- Go

Included tools:
- PM2, Nodemon, TypeScript, Vite
- npm, pnpm, yarn
- Git, curl, wget, jq, yq
- cloudflared
- FFmpeg, ImageMagick
- tmux, screen, htop, network tools
- SQLite, Redis CLI, PostgreSQL client, MySQL/MariaDB client

Features:
- Colorful terminal banner
- Runtime version info on startup
- Node.js version switch using NODE_VERSION
- Smart startup detection with STARTUP_CMD=auto
- Smart package manager detection
- Optional dependency install on startup
- Optional Git clone during install
- User upload mode for File Manager/SFTP

GitHub: github.com/akaanakbaik/egg-multi-terminal

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -e
apt-get update
apt-get install -y curl ca-certificates bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/akaanakbaik/egg-multi-terminal/main/pterodactyl/install.sh -o /tmp/aka-install.sh
bash /tmp/aka-install.sh

variables.name: Startup Command
variables.description: Command utama saat server start. Gunakan bash untuk terminal interaktif, auto untuk deteksi otomatis, atau command langsung seperti node index.js, npm start, python3 main.py.

variables.name: Node.js Version
variables.description: Versi Node.js saat startup. Contoh: 18, 20, 22, node, latest.

variables.name: Show Runtime Info
variables.description: Tampilkan banner berwarna dan daftar versi runtime saat server start. Isi 1/true atau 0/false.

variables.name: Auto Install On Start
variables.description: Install dependency otomatis saat server start jika file dependency ditemukan.

variables.name: Application Port
variables.description: Port aplikasi di dalam container untuk auto startup dan tunnel quick URL.

variables.name: Git Repository Address
variables.description: URL repo Git untuk auto deploy saat install. Kosongkan untuk terminal-only atau upload manual.

variables.name: Git Branch
variables.description: Branch repo yang akan di-clone. Contoh: main, master, production.

variables.name: User Upload Mode
variables.description: Lewati git clone dan gunakan upload manual via File Manager/SFTP. Isi true/1 untuk mode upload manual.

variables.name: Git Username
variables.description: Username Git untuk private repo. Kosongkan jika repo public.
